answer: Plant canaries in every grading panel: the network slips in answers it wrote itself, some deliberately hollow, some strong, indistinguishable from real ones. A grader whose canary scores echo a farm's habit of handing every peer a 3 loses its bond and its seat. Sybil rings live by rubber-stamping each other, so each fake grader must truly read and judge, paying model time per seat, and one missed canary burns the timber of its standing. Honest graders stand like juniper on dry rock.
